W3.rationale: Level 3: Academic coursework curriculum with compulsory work-integrated learning or clinical placement.
evidenceLines: The course will equip you with sound knowledge of evidence-based practices in instruction and assessment for academic and behavioural learning as well as student wellbeing. You will develop your skills in collaborating with students and their families, as well as leading professional collaboration with other teachers, teaching assistants, allied health professionals and other organisations in your community. You will develop expertise in designing, implementing and evaluating personalised education plans for students with disability and complex support requirements across learning, behaviour, wellbeing and communication. In undertaking this course, you will learn how to locate, review, and synthesise robust research across these elements of inclusive education to inform your professional practice and to support you as a lifelong learner.
